text: 9月12日上午，国家主席习近平乘专机赴新德里，应印度总理莫迪邀请，出席金砖国家领导人第十八次会晤。 陪同习近平出访的有：中共中央政治局常委、中央办公厅主任蔡奇，中共中央政治局委员、外交部部长王毅等。（央视）
text_en: On the morning of September 12, President Xi Jinping departed by special plane for New Delhi to attend the 18th BRICS Leaders' Meeting at the invitation of Indian Prime Minister Modi. Accompanying Xi on the visit were: Cai Qi, member of the Standing Committee of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee and Director of the General Office of the CPC Central Committee; Wang Yi, member of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee and Minister of Foreign Affairs; and others. (CCTV)
